description: The organisation that governs TISAX; publishes the TISAX Participant Handbook; operates the ENX portal and the exchange platform; registers participants and assessment scopes; contracts the TISAX audit providers
key_responsibilities: Governance of TISAX; participant and assessment scope registration; approval of registrations; operation of the ENX portal and exchange platform; contracting and control of audit providers; complaint management

description: Any company that has registered with TISAX; TISAX does not differentiate between customer and supplier - everyone who registered is a participant and participates in the exchange of information security assessment results
key_responsibilities: Accept and comply with the TISAX Participation General Terms and Conditions; maintain participant data and contacts in the ENX portal; register assessment scopes

description: The role of the participant (typically the supplier) that gets TISAX-assessed and shares its assessment result with other participants
key_responsibilities: Prepare and conduct the ISA self-assessment; select an audit provider; undergo the TISAX assessments; prepare corrective action plans; publish or share the assessment result

description: The role of the participant (typically the customer/partner) that requested the assessment and receives the assessment result; a company can act as active and passive participant at the same time
key_responsibilities: Request that partners get TISAX-assessed; provide its Participant ID and the required sharing level; receive and protect assessment results shared through the exchange platform

description: An audit provider contracted by ENX Association; only contracted audit providers may conduct TISAX assessments and only for registered TISAX participants; must be impartial and must not have had previous consulting assignments with the assessed company
key_responsibilities: Conduct the initial; corrective action plan and follow-up assessments; check the self-assessment; apply the assessment methods of the applicable assessment level; document findings; issue the TISAX assessment report; submit the assessment result to the exchange platform
qualification_requirements: Contract with ENX Association; freedom from conflicts of interest

description: The person of the audit provider who performs the assessment activities; leads the assessment team as assessment project leader
key_responsibilities: Examine documents and evidence; conduct planned and unplanned interviews; observe local conditions and the execution of processes; present findings in the closing meeting

description: The mandatory contact for the company as a TISAX participant that ENX Association uses to communicate with the participant; at least one alternate is recommended
key_responsibilities: Manage the company's participant data in the ENX portal; receive TISAX communication; receive assessment result information shared at higher sharing levels
qualification_requirements: Salutation; first and last name; job title; department; phone number; email address; preferred language; postal address (mandatory registration details)

description: The mandatory contact registered for each assessment scope
key_responsibilities: Act as the point of contact for the registered assessment scope
qualification_requirements: Same mandatory contact details as the participant main contact

role_title: Person in charge of information security
description: The person of the assessed company interviewed by the audit provider in an assessment in assessment level 2
key_responsibilities: Answer the audit provider's interview questions on the information security management system
